context: Yumiko and Hina spend time in the garden.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ひなちゃん、本当、花、咲いた、ね。
lines.en: Hina-chan, the flowers have really bloomed, haven't they?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely delighted observation. Soft opening on her daughter's name. Unhurried pace. Real pleasure in the moment—not performed, just present. Voice settles like she's sharing something precious.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Wow, they really are beautiful—so truly beautiful!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded awe. Quick intake on the opening exclamation. Voice rises naturally with her wonder, then softens slightly as she dwells on it. The kind of genuine astonishment only a child can give.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: I'm so happy we're looking at this together.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude underneath warmth. Leans into the word 'together'—this moment matters. Gentle, unhurried. A mother speaking something true she almost doesn't need to say aloud.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 優しい、お母さん、本当、好き。
lines.en: You're so kind, Mom—I really love you.
lines.style: Soft, direct sincerity. No shyness, no performance. The certainty of a child who feels safe enough to say the simple true thing. Voice warm and steady, eyes on her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: This is really fun, isn't it?
lines.style: Reflective close, almost to herself. Slower than before. Voice carries a quiet contentment—the kind that comes after a good moment, when you're already holding it as memory. Warmth doesn't fade, just deepens.
